178: 		boolean javaLangAsFqn = delombokOptions.getFormatPreferences().javaLangAsFqn();
179: 		boolean wantsConstructorProperties = delombokOptions.getFormatPreferences().generateConstructorProperties();

181: 		JavacNode enclosing = typeNode.directUp();
182: 		while (enclosing != null) {
183: 			if (enclosing.isStructurallySignificant()) {
184: 				break;
185: 			}
186: 			enclosing = enclosing.directUp();
187: 		}
188: 		boolean localType = false;
189: 		Kind enclosingKind = enclosing.getKind();
190: 		if (enclosingKind != Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) {
191: 			if (enclosingKind == Kind.TYPE) {
192: 				JavacNode nested = enclosing;
193: 				Kind nestedKind = nested.up().getKind();
194: 				if (nestedKind != Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) {
195: 					while (nestedKind == Kind.TYPE) {
196: 						nested = nested.up();
197: 						nestedKind = nested.up().getKind();
198: 					}
199: 					localType = nestedKind != Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT;
200: 				}
201: 			} else {
202: 				localType = true;
203: 			}
204: 		}
205: 
206: 		boolean addConstructorProperties;
207: 		if ((!msgParam && !causeParam) || localType || !wantsConstructorProperties) {
208: 			addConstructorProperties = false;
209: 		} else {
210: 			Boolean v = typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_ADD_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES);
211: 			addConstructorProperties = v != null ? v.booleanValue() :
212: 				Boolean.FALSE.equals(typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_SUPPRESS_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES));
213: 		}
214: 
215: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
216: 
217: 		if (msgParam) {
218: 			Name fieldName = typeNode.toName("message");
219: 			long flags = Flags.PARAMETER;
220: 			if (addFinal) {
221: 				flags |= Flags.FINAL;
222: 			}
223: 			JCExpression pType;
224: 			if (javaLangAsFqn) {
225: 				pType = maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("java"));
226: 				pType = maker.Select(pType, typeNode.toName("lang"));
227: 				pType = maker.Select(pType, typeNode.toName("String"));
228: 			} else {
229: 				pType = maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("String"));
230: 			}
231: 			JCVariableDecl param = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(flags), fieldName, pType, null);
232: 			params.append(param);
233: 		}
234: 
235: 		if (causeParam) {
236: 			Name fieldName = typeNode.toName("cause");
237: 			long flags = Flags.PARAMETER;
238: 			if (addFinal) {
239: 				flags |= Flags.FINAL;
240: 			}
241: 			JCExpression pType;
242: 			if (javaLangAsFqn) {
243: 				pType = maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("java"));
244: 				pType = maker.Select(pType, typeNode.toName("lang"));
245: 				pType = maker.Select(pType, typeNode.toName("Throwable"));
246: 			} else {
247: 				pType = maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("Throwable"));
248: 			}
249: 			JCVariableDecl param = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(flags), fieldName, pType, null);
250: 			params.append(param);
251: 		}
252: 
253: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(toJavacModifier(level), List.<JCAnnotation>nil());

258: 	}

262: 		if (kind == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return false;
263: 		if (kind == Kind.TYPE) return isLocalType(type.up());
